name: A & E Kitchen Service LLC
old_description: A & E Kitchen Service LLC, founded in 2000 provides service for our customers and manufacturers of commercial kitchen equipment.  Servicing commercial cooking, preparation, holding, sanitation, refrigeration, warewashing equipment and HVAC needs for restaurants, churches, convenience stores, hospitals, hotels, schools, and institutions throughout southwest Missouri.
about:
A & E Kitchen Service LLC was founded in 2000 in Springfield, Missouri. The company provides service and support for commercial kitchen equipment manufacturers and end users across southwest Missouri, including the Springfield, Branson, and Joplin areas.

The firm operates a field service force of five technicians, a dispatcher, and a parts manager. Its technicians, who average 15 years of experience and hold certifications in electric, gas, steam, and refrigeration systems, perform on-site repair, installation, start-up, preventive maintenance, and factory-authorized warranty work on cooking, preparation, holding, sanitation, refrigeration, warewashing, and HVAC equipment. The shop also handles minor construction, electrical, plumbing, and welding tasks.

Customers range from independent restaurants, churches, convenience stores, hospitals, hotels, schools, and other institutions to equipment manufacturers such as Hobart, Hoshizaki, Vulcan, and more than 150 other brands for which A & E provides factory-authorized warranty service.

The company emphasizes direct technician contact—no call center—and offers 24-hour weekend and emergency response. Its combination of geographic coverage and technical breadth allows clients to consolidate their food-service equipment support under one provider.

name: A & W Sheet Metal and Industrial Contractors, LLC
old_description: Located at West Monroe, LA. A & W Sheet Metal and Industrial Contractors, LLC Specializes in metal fabrication, sheet metal work, TIG welding, drilling, grinding, etc. Free Estimates. Family-Owned Business. In Business for 35+ Years. Call us for a FREE estimate.
about:
A & W Sheet Metal and Industrial Contractors, LLC operates from West Monroe, Louisiana. The company was founded over 35 years ago by Rick Auttonberry as a Christian family-owned business. Auttonberry's goal was to deliver high-quality metal fabrication at competitive prices while prioritizing safety for employees and customers and meeting tight schedules, a mission the firm says still guides it today.

The shop specializes in commercial and industrial ductwork, CNC high-definition plasma cutting, welding, and automated metal fabrication. It also provides industrial plant maintenance, millwright services, and multi-skilled mechanical contracting. Equipment includes CNC plasma cutting and plate rolling capacity up to 3/8-inch bending and 1/2-inch rolling. Additional capabilities cover paper machine hood structural work and inspections, false ceiling installation, P.V. systems, machine guarding, ductwork, chute fabrication, fan maintenance and rebuilds, and structural platforms, catwalks, handrails, stairs, and ladder cages. HVAC installation, maintenance, and repair are offered alongside legacy technology support. The company services projects across Louisiana, Texas, Arkansas, Mississippi, and Alabama, with technicians available on call 24 hours a day.

Customers come from packaging, paper, biomass, aluminum, plastics, healthcare, and education sectors. Named clients include Graphic Packaging, Georgia Pacific, International Paper, WestRock, Clearwater Paper, Drax Biomass, Green Bay Packaging, SAPA, Bemis, and PCA, as well as hospitals, universities, and schools.

The firm emphasizes its family-owned heritage, free estimates, and a safety-first culture rooted in its founding principles.

old_description: We are professional printers providing outstanding custom graphics on a wide selection of apparel. Our business was founded by husband and wife team Bruce & Cheryl Burkland. Their vision was to assemble a team of the best graphic designers and silkscreen printers to produce and WOW customers with apparel prints. Our name, "A Team" is in reference to the quality of outstanding employees. It just doesn't get any better than us. Our quick turn around time, creative graphic design, and reasonable pricing keeps us popular and busy. Over 1 million T-shirts designed and printed, and never missed a deadline. Never!
about:
Based in Prairie City, Iowa, A Team Apparel was founded by husband-and-wife team Bruce and Cheryl Burkland. In 2026, the business was purchased by Libby, who had launched 515 Creative Designs in 2018, and the two operations merged under the name 515 A*Team.

The company provides custom apparel decoration through screen printing and direct-to-film (DTF) heat press, supplemented by in-house graphic design. It sources a wide range of garments — including ringspun cotton, tri-blend, and performance-fabric tees, fleece, outerwear, and headwear — and reports having produced over one million printed shirts. Orders start at 12 pieces for screen printing, with price breaks at 25, 37, 51, and 101 units; DTF is available for smaller runs.

Customers include event organizers, promotional-product buyers, and corporate clients. A noted example is Crossroads of Pella, which has relied on the shop for its annual Klompen Classic race T-shirts.

The founders’ original vision was to assemble a team of designers and printers to “wow” customers with print quality. The company emphasizes quick turnaround, creative design included at no extra charge with an order, and a dedicated style advisor who helps select exclusive apparel options.

about:
A-Auto Salvage opened its doors in 1990 in Little Rock, Arkansas. The business is family owned and operated, drawing on a combined experience of over 50 years in the automotive industry. The founders, though not named individually, established the salvage yard to serve the local market with used and new auto parts.

The company operates a salvage yard where customers can hand-pick parts from late-model and older vehicles, including cars and trucks that many other suppliers no longer stock. Inventory covers engines, transmissions, tires, batteries, rear ends, and interior pieces for a wide range of makes — from Ford, GM, and Dodge to Honda, Toyota, BMW, and Mercedes-Benz. In addition to parts sales, A-Auto Salvage provides auto repair services such as fuel system work and manufacturer-recommended maintenance. The yard also offers same-day pickup for vehicle purchases and a parts-locating service for hard-to-find items.

The business serves Pulaski, Saline, Garland, Lonoke, and Jefferson counties, supplying both individual vehicle owners and repair shops. Its customer base includes anyone needing affordable replacement parts for domestic and import models, as well as those seeking professional installation and maintenance.

A-Auto Salvage emphasizes hands-on service, competitive pricing, and the assurance that a live person always answers the phone. The company says its reputation rests on expertise and a high customer satisfaction rate, with same-day vehicle pickup and the ability to source obscure parts setting it apart from larger, less personal operations.

name: A-Pac Manufacturing
old_description: We are your trusted, industry-leading manufacturer of made to order, high-quality poly bags and plastic film products made right here in the USA.
about:
A-Pac Manufacturing was founded in 1988 in Grand Rapids, Michigan. The company began as a custom manufacturer of poly bags and plastic film products, built on a commitment to direct customer relationships.

The company produces custom poly bags, plastic liners, plastic film and tubing, polyethylene tubing, and SWS and CF sheeting to customer specifications. Operations rely on invested machinery for control and accuracy, with standard lead times of two to three weeks. Certifications include ISO 9001:2015 and FSSC 22000, both certified by Intertek.

A-Pac serves medical, food and beverage, and industrial packaging sectors. Long-term customers include Oliver Products Medical Division, which has sourced clean, high-quality bags since 2007, and R.W. Bakers, which has used A-Pac poly bags for baked goods since 2002. The sales and customer service team, led by Sales Manager Kyle Poe and Customer Service Manager Tracy Korynta, works directly with buyers to develop custom solutions.

The company emphasizes U.S.-made products from premium raw materials, fast turnaround, and a quality management system focused on continual improvement. Its founding principle centers on going beyond typical supplier expectations through custom-made bags and responsive, person-to-person service.

about:
A-Z Solar Services operates from Mandeville, Louisiana, in the Greater New Orleans area. The company is owned and operated by solar energy installers who turned their passion for renewable energy into a profession.

The firm designs custom solar electric and solar hot water systems, handling both new installations and maintenance. It specializes in hybrid, grid-tie, and off-grid applications, and also provides general electrical services under the name "Next Level Electrical Service." The installer who performs the site analysis also designs the system and carries out the installation, seeing the project through from start to finish.

A-Z Solar Services serves residential and commercial customers in the Greater New Orleans region seeking renewable energy solutions. Its clients include homeowners and businesses looking for grid-tied, off-grid, or hybrid solar installations, as well as those needing electrical service work.

The company was built on the principle that the technician who understands the system should be the one communicating with the customer. By eliminating a separate sales force, A-Z Solar Services aims to create a lifelong relationship between the installer and the customer, ensuring continuity from initial analysis through ongoing support.

old_description: A2Z EMS specializes in high-mix, low-volume PCB production with fast turnaround times. Whether it is prototyping or producing in small batches, our flexible processes are designed to meet your exact specifications with quality and speed.
about:
A2Z Electronics LLC operates from Elgin, Illinois, as an electronics contract manufacturer specializing in printed circuit board assembly and turnkey box-build services. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The firm provides end-to-end manufacturing including surface-mount (SMT) and through-hole (THT) PCB assembly, BGA placement with X-ray inspection, cable and wire harness fabrication, box-build integration, conformal coating and potting, and engineering support for design-for-manufacturability. Its facility houses a Panasonic high-speed pick-and-place machine capable of 25 µm placement accuracy. Production cycles range from same-day and 24-hour turns for prototypes to 3-day and 5-day options for low-volume runs, scaling to high-volume orders.

A2Z serves customers in medical devices, transportation systems, defense systems, lighting technology, industrial applications, aerospace systems, and consumer electronics. Its client base spans startups to established OEMs requiring high-mix, low-volume flexibility.

The company emphasizes rapid turnaround with just-in-time capabilities, a certified quality system (ISO 13485, AS9100D, ITAR, RoHS), responsive support targeting 24-hour replies, and cost-effective scalable pricing.

about:
AAA Auto Wrecking has operated from Kent, Washington, in the Puget Sound region since 1973. The company began as an auto wrecking and recycling yard, serving local vehicle owners and repair shops with salvaged parts.

The yard specializes in auto parts recycling, dismantling vehicles to recover reusable components. It maintains an on-site inventory of used parts for a wide range of makes and models, and offers a special-order service to source components not immediately available on the lot.

AAA Auto Wrecking serves the automotive aftermarket across the Puget Sound area, supplying used parts to individual vehicle owners, independent repair shops, and collision centers. Its inventory covers parts for virtually any vehicle, from domestic to import models.

The company emphasizes affordable pricing and a deep local presence, positioning itself as a go-to source for cost-effective replacement parts. Its ability to special-order hard-to-find items extends the practical reach of its on-hand stock.
